items.headline: SoftBank launches $11B+ junk bond sale to fund next OpenAI investment tranche
items.note: SoftBank is issuing over $11B in senior unsecured bonds (on top of an already-secured $11.87B loan) to fund the $10B follow-on OpenAI payment due Oct 1, coming right after S&P moved its outlook to negative and its CDS widened to multi-year highs — concrete evidence SoftBank is loading junk-rated debt onto what S&P calls one of its weakest-credit holdings.

items.headline: CoreWeave upsizes convertible note sale to $3.7B, prices coupon at 2.875% — up from 1.75% in April
items.note: The upsized deal priced with a coupon roughly 64% higher than CoreWeave's prior 2032 convertible from April, and the initial announcement knocked the stock down ~7%, despite the company also touting $25B of new customer commitments — a real-time read on CoreWeave's rising cost of capital.

items.headline: CleanSpark's debut junk bond for Meta-anchored data center prices at 8.25% yield despite 4x oversubscription
items.note: First-ever junk bond backed by a Meta data-center lease (Sandersville, GA; $6.6B/20-yr lease) priced to yield 8.25%, about 1.75pp over the average BB-rated yield — a data point that even Meta-anchored AI infrastructure debt is clearing at speculative-grade pricing.
